builder.title: Build a rotation
builder.intro: Place a crop in each of the three seasons, then press Grow to play it in the 3D view. Only rotations this field was ranked on can be built.
builder.missing: The rotation builder needs this field's simulation inputs, which are not available.
builder.slotLabel: Season {n}: {crop}. Select to place a crop here.
builder.hint: Tap a crop to place it in season {n}, or drag it onto a season.
builder.reason.needs_crop: Needs at least one harvested crop.
builder.reason.two_non_crop: No two non-crop seasons (fallow, cover crop) in a row.
builder.reason.family_run: At most {n} seasons in a row of the same plant family ({family}).
builder.reason.not_ranked: No ranked rotation of this field fits with the other seasons.
builder.notReady: Fill all three seasons with an allowed rotation.
builder.noCurrent: The current rotation has a season that is not simulated, so there is no comparison with it.
builder.provenance: Table values come from the field's ranking (3 seasons, all weather years). The 3D replay is simulated in your browser with the same FAO-56 water balance as the 3D packs (parity-tested) for one median-rain year.
sim3d.builderNotice: Showing your rotation, simulated in your browser (same model as the 3D packs, parity-tested). Weather: normal, dry (−20 % rain) or hot (+2 °C) only.
builder.openHint: Put a crop in each of three seasons and watch it grow next to your current rotation.
